items.title: 63475_Arnett Cobb oral history interview
items.q: the Wantz Brothers came over to me and talked to me about working that club... they were going to work me two weeks

ctx.x: I told you it was giving me trouble, but after I'd gone to California I was getting all right then, but not all right either in a sense of the word, so I thought if I just take off about six months -- I'll give you a thing that happened. We was in Philadelphia at the Earl Theater and the Wantz Brothers came over to me and talked to me about working that club, and I knew we was going to be off at Easter, so they were going to work me two weeks. And I took it for the money that they was going to pay me because I'd…

But, see, Gladys went over -- when they told Gladys and Hamp when they went over to the club they was hiring me on that for Easter, Gladys said, you didn't come through me. And they come back and told -- I said, come through her? I wasn't working there. We off Easter. Thought they going to dominate my life. I won't be there anyway. This is why I leave. Nobody knows but me and my wife, why I left.
